family_grammar.whole_first: an episode is a whole: its movements are staged in order so the ending (the quilting return) qualifies the beginning (the opening poem) — no epilogue text, the return rides the sequencing
family_grammar.structure_staging: one formation cluster per movement's own image: the O (poem), sun + orbit (definitional ground), the emptied symbol, the descending sixfold chain, the four portrait plates, the concentric rings, the split whole, the empty centre ring, word harmonics, the gathering return ring
family_grammar.read_blocks: READ-block titles are carried verbatim in page text; the spoken body is compressed, never paraphrased into new claims
family_grammar.held_material: the script's own 'Held for 0.2 / 0.3' lists are respected — material reserved for later episodes is not staged

note: An episode's scenes are one record (the script) bound per-movement by heading anchors; per-scene sha256 values all pin the same record bytes.
